hints.content:
The measure of an arc is equal to the measure of the [[☃ definition 1]] that intercepts it.

By that reasoning, the arc measure of minor arc $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{BC}$ is the acute measure of $\angle BPC$.  We need to find the measure of  major arc $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{BDC}$, which is the [[☃ definition 2]] of minor arc $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{BC}$.

hints.content:
The measures of $\angle BPC$ and $\angle APD$ are congruent because they are vertical angles.  So:

$\begin{align}
m\angle BPC &= m\angle APD
\\\\
4k+159 &= 2k+153
\\\\
2k+159 &= 153
\\\\
2k &= -6
\\\\
k &=  -3
\end{align}$

We can use the value of $k$ to evaluate the measure of $\angle BPC$.  Let's substitute in our value for $k$.

$\begin{align}
m\angle BPC&= 4k+159^\circ
\\\\
&=4(-3)+159^\circ
\\\\
&=-12+159^\circ
\\\\
&=147^\circ
\end{align}$

There are $360^\circ$ in a circle, so the measure of any major arc is equal to $360^\circ$ minus the measure of the corresponding minor arc.

$m\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{BDC} \,= 360^\circ-147^\circ$
